payload.summary: Lighthouse budget grades the same commit differently at PR time and post-merge, so a required check can fail on code that already passed it
payload.detail: Make the Lighthouse grading deterministic between the PR run and the post-merge run — retry once, or widen the tolerance — so the same SHA cannot get two verdicts. Why: it is a REQUIRED gate, so a non-deterministic answer turns pr-required red on main for changes that were green on the PR, which is part of what trains the team to ignore a red main. Context: two dependency-bump merges (runs 35392321128 and 35384830844) failed pr-required solely on Lighthouse budget post-merge. Owner: assistant. Confidence: medium — the two runs are verified, the determinism mechanism is not yet root-caused. Depends on: #T82ND3.
payload.source: session 2026-09-20 /ledger sweep — nine-agent repo maturity review
